text: hey everybody I don't think there's any such thing as a Biblical literalist at least I've never seen one there are plenty of people who will assert we have
to approach certain passages literally in the Bible but every last one of them will also insist that we have to
approach many other passages figuratively where a literal reading would undermine their structuring of power their boundary maintenance their
identity politics those interests are always the priority the Bible is not the priority understanding what the Bible is
saying is not the priority it's serving those interests because that's the authority the Bible is just the proof
text and to the degree the Bible does not serve those interests it must be re-read it must be reinterpreted we've
got to find out how to use it in a different way and so for these folks it's not literalism about the Bible it's literalism about their ideologies and
their identity politics and the Bible is just a tool to advance those in interests
